summary: 假设A(近中性)机制真实:自底向上宏观测算AI十年TFP增幅≤0.66%(温和),任务级证据显示AI多为增强(客服+14%、新手+34%),互补/生产率/再创造可抵消替代——'温和数据=真中性'有据;但机制成立≠已证净中性。

evidence.title: Acemoglu — Simple Macroeconomics of AI
evidence.quote: no more than a 0.66% increase in total factor productivity (TFP) over 10 years
evidence.note: 宏观生产率冲击温和→劳动需求冲击温和

evidence.title: Generative AI at Work (Brynjolfsson/Li/Raymond)
evidence.quote: increases productivity, as measured by issues resolved per hour, by 14% on average, including a 34% improvement for novice and low-skilled workers

open_questions: 互补带来的产出扩张是否足以通过新任务把净就业拉回正(reinstatement)?
